description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for F5 BIG-IP syslog, ASM/iRule, and JSON access events. Extends upstream SC4S F5 BIG-IP routing inventory with conservative Library metadata, fixtures, Splunk knowledge, and explicit validation gaps.

data_structures: Base BIG-IP syslog umbrella parser route

explicit_gaps: No live BIG-IP appliance, BIG-IP source version, or production-equivalent relay was exercised by adding this harness.

The harness uses synthetic-equivalent fixture syslog/iRule/ASM/access_json records and does not prove custom iRule payload completeness, ASM policy semantics, TLS forwarding configuration, module-specific optional fields, or complete upstream F5 parser coverage.
Passing the harness would be lab replay/read-back evidence for this fixture route only, not field validation for a real BIG-IP deployment.

test_event_sets.label: F5 BIG-IP BSD/RFC5424 mixed syslog fixtures

timestamp_policy.primary_timezone: BSD fixtures require source/receiver timezone; RFC5424 fixture includes UTC offset
timestamp_policy.notes: BIG-IP often emits BSD syslog without offset; prefer RFC5424/RFC5425 or configure source timezone explicitly.

field_delimiting.field_separator: commas for iRule key/value examples; JSON object for access_json
field_delimiting.escape_policy: Synthetic-equivalent fixtures avoid secrets/customer identifiers and use RFC5737/example.test values.
field_delimiting.notes: Each line is self-contained; deployments may customize iRule JSON fields.

source.reference: Upstream SC4S generated entries f5_bigip, f5_bigip_irule_asm, f5_bigip_irule_json, f5_bigip_irule_splunk, and f5_bigip_structured; upstream SC4S docs/sources/vendor/F5/bigip.md; upstream parser files under package/etc/conf.d/conflib/syslog and netsource.
source.notes: Fixtures use RFC5737 and example.test identities and do not include customer samples, secrets, tokens, or proprietary Splunk TA content.

curation.notes: Selected from demand research as a high-value enterprise gap after recent Cisco/Fortinet/Zscaler work. Conservative pack only; validation evidence is still required.

action.notes: Splunk props derive fixture-backed family actions such as ssl_error, tcl_error, traffic_limit, dns_request, dns_response, lb_failed, or coalesce source-provided event_type/method/violations values. This is partial CIM action coverage only.
